// BB-6904 rev 12 (7379): a verse counts as named when any later round of the answering side names it, later than the round that first cites it.
 const citedNotNamed=(rounds,answers)=>{const O=['[CR1]','[DR1]','[CR2]','[DR2]','[CR3]','[DR3]'];const NA=answers.map(([k,t])=>[O.indexOf(k),namedIn(t)]);let total=0;const not=[];for(const x of citedRounds(rounds)){const at=O.indexOf(x.name);const Ns=NA.filter(a=>a[0]>at).map(a=>a[1]);for(const i of x.items){total++;if(!Ns.some(N=>i.r.cvs.some(cv=>isNamed(N,i.r.book,cv))))not.push(i.label);}}return {total,not};};
